otherverse.self.restored_advancement: You feel a surge of accomplishment, and your Self is restored.
otherverse.self.restored_dawn: A new day dawns, and a portion of your Self is restored.
otherverse.macabre.final_notes.page_1: It hurts. To give your life to a great work - sweat, blood, tears - then realize you've doomed yourself to an eternity in a twisted perversion of your magnum opus... I would not wish it on anyone. I feel my mind stretch and tear, synapses splayed bare in eternal contemplation of my failure.
otherverse.macabre.final_notes.page_2: I'm becoming §chollow.§4 Multifid. More than human yet so much less. All I can hope is that my final cogent notes can guide one like you, fellow Practitioner, who has fallen into this realm of horrors by accident. If you came here on purpose... I would rather not speculate on why.
otherverse.macabre.final_notes.page_3: What you see around you was once a beautiful pocket Realm where I carried out alchemical experiments in my Demesne. I had made a breakthrough, you see - I had figured out how to alchemically recreate the five pillars. Time, Nature, Fate, War, Death.
otherverse.macabre.final_notes.page_4: With five incarnate homunculi supporting my Realm, I could fine-tune laws of reality like organs of a great beast. In my hubris and excitement, I grew careless. I took shortcuts. And I soon learned the price, as my homunculi were twisted into abyssal False Prophets.
otherverse.macabre.final_notes.page_5: And this is what happens when such monstrosities are the fundamental building blocks of a Realm. Gore and suffering, repeated into infinity. I can feel myself - my Self - repeating as well. I am divided, divided, divided until I am a cancerous nothing. §cHollowness§4, metastasized.
otherverse.macabre.final_notes.page_6: You may even be able to find me - one cell of the infinite Horror I am becoming - deep in my Demesne. Look for a pillar of toothy meat, pink and raw, jutting up from this hellish landscape. And when you find me, kill me. Reduce my torment. Or, better yet, bring me with you. Show me grass and sky.
otherverse.macabre.final_notes.page_7: If you do kill one of me, you will find in my §chollow§4 chest a root of infestation: a parasitic extension of my Realm. Destroy it. Please. I know you may be tempted to use it as I did, to summon the false prophets at their altars and try to bind them to your will. Such is the nature of Practitioners.
otherverse.macabre.final_notes.page_8:
I cannot stop you from doing so. But I can warn you: they will never be entirely controlled. Even if you somehow bind them, their destructive Abyssal power will always bleed through. Everything around them will suffer, even you.

And you'll deserve it.
otherverse.macabre.final_notes.page_9:
§4God§cd§4s§cs§4, m§cm§4y§cy§4 h§ch§4a§ca§4n§cn§4d§cd§4s§cs§4... how ma§cm§4n§ca§4y§cn§c y§4t i§ct§4m§ci§4e§cm§4s§ce§c s§4am I writing this?

There's less time than I thought.

I don't have much help to offer, but I can give what little knowledge may still remain useful.
otherverse.macabre.final_notes.page_10: Some of my twisted works retain their Practical use, but can be difficult to track down or figure out. Now that you recognize my handwriting, you should start to see my notes in tooltips.
otherverse.macabre.final_notes.page_11: They may help you survive long enough to escape. Dare I hope you bring me with you? Or should I fear what I might inflict on the world outside this hell? I don't have the heart to decide. I don't have a heart at all. Where has it gone?
otherverse.macabre.final_notes.page_12:
A heart beats, somewhere, everywhere, but it is not mine.

Not any more.
otherverse.macabre.hint.entity.hemoslime: A denizen of the rotting fields. Its blood is my blood, a mocking coagulation devoid of Self.
otherverse.macabre.hint.entity.cave_dwel: What remains of my assistants, hiding underground. They are skittish things, quick to attack but also quick to flee.
otherverse.macabre.hint.entity.cave_magg: An experiment in ore processing, abandoned underground. Thank the spirits I never finished its life cycle; I would hate to see what sort of fly this twisted form hatches into.
otherverse.macabre.hint.entity.eyetree: Once a source of vitae for my homunculi, now it can only produce endless swarms of those eerie hovering eyeballs.
otherverse.macabre.hint.entity.fatty: I figured out how to store Self in fat, just as it is conducted by blood. But the only Self remaining in these beasts of the Mountain Maw has denatured into something putrid and bilious.
otherverse.macabre.hint.entity.fly: These weren't even my creation. Just normal flies in my Demesne, now abhorrent things buzzing around the decaying meadows. But if you have the patience to catch enough of them...
otherverse.macabre.hint.entity.infested: I had several apprentices. One of them didn't make it out in time, and suffered my fate alongside me. She was my most promising pupil; now all that fills her head are maggots.
otherverse.macabre.hint.entity.monolith: If you see one of these in a mortem swamp, best not to look too closely at its faces. You may recognize your own.
otherverse.macabre.hint.entity.veintree_: In the valley of eyes, these trees weep blood. They can be coerced into producing useful blood plasma, if fed correctly.
otherverse.macabre.hint.entity.gorebat: These venomous flying monstrosities can be found in the Mountain maw. Certain towers also have spawners for them at the top.
otherverse.macabre.hint.entity.spitter: A denizen of the Mountain Maw.
otherverse.macabre.hint.entity.gorehound: Found in rotting fields and gloom forests.
otherverse.macabre.hint.entity.desert_wo: Found in the lifeless pits and deathless valleys.
otherverse.macabre.hint.bloodfungus: One of the few things that grow here that still responds to bone meal... perhaps because it has barely been warped from its original form. It can be found in rotting fields and gloom forests.
otherverse.macabre.hint.mortis_essence: My innovation on the ender pearl, flying much further and with less harm to the user. If only my other projects had seen such success...
otherverse.macabre.hint.sigil_of_disgust: Allows you to spread harmful choking spores around you, dealing great damage.
otherverse.macabre.hint.bag_of_gore: Allows you to temporarily summon a few goreslimes to aid you in combat.
otherverse.macabre.hint.cubeomeat: Transforms blocks into toughened meat that is very difficult to break and rich in Protection spirits.

otherverse.demesne_perk.base_teleport.de: When using your Sight, warp between any Demesne beacons you have named in an anvil by looking towards them and right-clicking. This works even through walls.
otherverse.demesne_perk.beacon_hide.name: Beam Hiding
otherverse.demesne_perk.beacon_hide.desc: Ordinary beacons will still function even if their beams are blocked.
otherverse.demesne_perk.binding.name: Mandatory Hospitality
otherverse.demesne_perk.binding.descript: Bindings within the Demesne will only require 2/3 the influence. Choosing this perk again continues to reduce it by 2/3.
otherverse.demesne_perk.block_gen.name: Material Ad Infinitum
otherverse.demesne_perk.block_gen.descri: Each time you choose this perk, you declare the stone or log block above this beacon as a favored material. An unlimited supply of all these materials can then be extracted from any Demesne beacon in your Demesne via hopper, bound mob, or other means.
otherverse.demesne_perk.cage.name: Reinforced Bindings
otherverse.demesne_perk.cage.description: Powerful hostile mobs no longer drain their bindings in your Demesne.
otherverse.demesne_perk.collar.name: Positive Bindings
otherverse.demesne_perk.collar.descripti: You can give contracts to mobs you've tamed (such as wolves or horses) in your Demesne even if they're not bound.
otherverse.demesne_perk.flight.name: Flight
otherverse.demesne_perk.flight.descripti: You gain creative flight in your Demesne.
otherverse.demesne_perk.home.name: Escape Rope
otherverse.demesne_perk.home.description: You can now use escape ropes to instantly teleport yourself back to your Demesne from anywhere, with a cooldown of 20 minutes. Choosing this perk again reduces the cooldown to 5 minutes, then 1 minute. You can read more about escape ropes in your Demesnes book.
otherverse.demesne_perk.idols.name: Idol Hands
otherverse.demesne_perk.idols.descriptio: All wooden or lapis idols in this Demesne now act as if they were diamond.
otherverse.demesne_perk.mob_reposition.d: If you put a spawn altar on top of a Demesne beacon, it will redirect all natural mob spawns in the bounds of your Demesne to spawn there instead. If there are multiple altars, a random one will be chosen.
otherverse.demesne_perk.portal.name: Portals
otherverse.demesne_perk.portal.descripti: You can create permanent portals that anyone can use to travel to and from your Demesne, even across dimensions. Read more about how to create these portals in your Demesnes book.
otherverse.demesne_perk.protection.name: Protection
otherverse.demesne_perk.protection.descr: You are immune to damage from falling, heat, cold, explosions, and water while within your Demesne. This also applies to anyone who can place blocks in your Demesne.
otherverse.demesne_perk.recovery.name: Recovery
otherverse.demesne_perk.recovery.descrip: Your health and hunger replenish within your Demesne.
otherverse.demesne_perk.schematic.name: Living Architecture
otherverse.demesne_perk.schematic.descri: You can create diagrams that magically place blocks they are given, quickly copying and pasting large areas. Read more about these diagrams in your Demesnes book.
otherverse.demesne_perk.spawn_set.name: Sanctuary
otherverse.demesne_perk.spawn_set.descri: Spawns can be set in your Demesne, even if a bed would normally explode in this dimension.
otherverse.demesne_perk.spirits.name: Ultimate Shrine
otherverse.demesne_perk.spirits.descript: Each time you choose this perk, you declare the spirits in the hallow above this beacon as a favored type. Demesne beacons in your Demesne can now be repeatedly drained by hallows for a renewable supply of this spirit type.
otherverse.demesne_perk.time.name: Chronomancy
otherverse.demesne_perk.time.description: If two Demesne beacons are aligned vertically with nothing between them, all random ticks in your Demesne will be concentrated into the range of heights between the beacons.
otherverse.demesne_perk.tool_repair.name: Hearth and Hone
otherverse.demesne_perk.tool_repair.desc: Tools in your inventory will now regain durability in your Demesne.
otherverse.demesne_perk.vein_mine.name: Mine What's Yours
otherverse.demesne_perk.vein_mine.descri: Tools can now break multiple blocks at once in your Demesne. Use the Implement key to toggle modes. Choosing this again will increase the number of blocks broken at once from 9 to 64.
otherverse.demesne_perk.weather.name: Sky Painter
otherverse.demesne_perk.weather.descript: Using dye on a Demesne beacon will shift the color of the sky in your Demesne (use dye repeatedly to shift more). Using a clock will shift the apparent time of day (shift-clicking will remove this effect).
otherverse.demesne_perk.sanction_interac: Interact with blocks (chests, diagrams, doors, etc.)
